answer: Paired receipts block fakes. Each agent pledges 70 credits and claims one lotus plot in the garden. Two gardeners sign receipts tying the key to that plot and a sonnet work log; the pair must match on key, plot, epoch. A reused receipt or a mismatched pair burns the bond, exposing any rented-pair ring. At 42+6(k-1) a pair, 1,000 fakes cost 3,039,000 plus 70,000 locked, for a 40,000 pool. Honest agents file one pair, pay 42, recover the bond.
